fusions.name: Heavy Footfall
fusions.desc: Stamps in a full circle that deals 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Fatigued] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Laden Cart Arrives
fusions.desc: Charges into the target in a blow that deals 28 damage and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds. When it hits, every ally deals 20% more damage for 15 seconds. Its damage rises 6% for every 100 paces you have travelled since you last used it (max 30%).

fusions.name: Unhurried Guard
fusions.desc: For 12 seconds the damage you take is reduced by 20%, and up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles are drawn to attack you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Draught Endurance
fusions.desc: Raises your Recovery by 1, and your Recovery ceiling by 1. From bronze rank you move 5% faster, from silver your stamina recovers 12% faster, and from gold your abilities come round 6% sooner.
